tools.name: list_digests
tools.description: Newest-first list of every published energypod.io edition (slugs + episode counts).

tools.name: get_digest
tools.description: Full briefing markdown + metadata for one edition. ``slug`` is the YYYY-MM-DD edition date.

tools.name: list_digest_episodes
tools.description: The episodes a given edition references (title + show + URL) — the cheapest way to map a week.

tools.name: get_episode
tools.description: One episode's title, show, summary, and transcript. Scoped to episodes referenced by a published digest. Pass ``digest`` when an episode spans more than one week.

tools.name: search
tools.description: The site's typo-tolerant search over digests, episodes, people, and companies (same ranking + excerpts as /search).

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
